result.markdown:
# Postmortem: Checkout failures after dependency upgrade

Severity: SEV2 · Blameless: focus on systems and decisions, not people.

## Impact
11% of checkout attempts returned 500 for 55 minutes; 1,240 orders delayed, none lost.

## Metrics
- Time to detect: 32 min
- Time to mitigate: 23 min
- Time to resolve: 140 min

## Timeline (UTC)
- 2026-10-02T13:05:00Z: Deploy 2026.10.02-1 with pg driver upgrade
- 2026-10-02T13:10:00Z: Connection pool exhaustion starts
- 2026-10-02T13:42:00Z: Customer support reports failures; no alert fired
- 2026-10-02T14:05:00Z: Rollback to previous image
- 2026-10-02T15:30:00Z: Backlog drained, metrics normal

## Contributing factors
- Pool size default changed in the driver major version
- No alert on 5xx ratio
- Canary stage skipped for a dependency-only change

## What went well
- Rollback took 4 minutes
- Queue preserved orders

## Action items
| Kind | Action | Owner | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| detect | Alert on 5xx ratio above 2% for 5 minutes | platform-team | 2026-10-16 |
| prevent | Canary mandatory for every deploy, including dependency bumps | orders-team | 2026-10-23 |
| prevent | Pin driver major version and add pool-size integration test | orders-team | 2026-10-30 |

## Review
Schedule a review of action items at the latest due date. Close this document only with evidence that each action shipped.
